**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation") shipped at 02:14:00Z. The connection pool went from healthy (3-11 of 20 in use) to pinned at `in_use=20 idle=0` within two minutes and never recovered. Every failing request logs the same pair:
```
ERROR access  <req-id> <path> -> <svc> 503 <latency>ms
ERROR pool    <req-id> ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```

**Impact window:** started 2026-03-14 02:14:14Z, still ongoing at the end of the log (03:59:27Z) with the wait queue climbing steadily (up to 232). Gateway-only — `worker.log` shows all jobs finishing normally the whole time, so downstream services and job processing were unaffected.

**Rollback:** revert `dep-4471` on the gateway.
